fields.System.Title: Add payment terms to customers
fields.System.Description:
As a finance clerk I want each customer to have payment terms so that due dates follow the contract instead of a fixed 30 days.

This story only stores and exposes the value. Using it for due dates is a follow-up.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
• Customer.PaymentTermsDays (int), default 14, allowed range 0–120.
  • Exposed in GET /api/customers as paymentTermsDays.
  • EF Core migration named AddCustomerPaymentTerms with a working Down(). Existing customers get 14.
  • Seed data updated with a fixed value per customer.
  • Unit and integration tests.
